panel_qc.lag_alignment: lag 1 is the same region's exposure at calendar month t-1; first rows and rows without an adjacent prior calendar month are dropped

design.knots_source: 15th, 50th, and 85th percentiles of all observed panel factual monthly temperatures before lag-row dropping

metadata.design_source: c07_bai_frozen.design S1 two-lag ordering, with each temperature basis centered at the panel factual median

fit.family_and_link: Poisson log-link pseudo-likelihood with log population offset
fit.fit_method: fixed_design.fit_tw; component-specific two-way region/year/intersection CR1 covariance
fit.base_interval_status: model-based approximate interval; no exact coverage claim

sensitivity_class.constraints: |b(T)'u| <= delta for all observed factual and counterfactual basis rows in both mapped lag blocks, centered at the fixed panel factual median Tref

main_delta_result.design_source: c07_bai_frozen.design S1 two-lag ordering, with each temperature basis centered at the panel factual median
main_delta_result.constraint_grid: All observed factual and counterfactual basis rows for every explicitly mapped lag block; finite support only.
main_delta_result.class_scope: conditional sensitivity bound for the stated finite-grid and fixed-allocation perturbation class

adversarial_sample_checks.sample_scope: all enumerated vertices, both LP optimizers, and seeded convex combinations; diagnostics only, with the row-wise remainder supplying the class-wide argument
